messages:
chloe: Hi team, quick onboarding question — I'm setting up Console + FF access this week. For staging I definitely need admin to reproduce a few things, but for prod I want to be conservative. What exact roles should I request to be able to toggle a flag briefly and run integration tests against the Console API? cc @ben
ben: Welcome aboard! For staging: request `console-staging-admin` (or `console-staging-readonly` if you only need to inspect). For prod: request `console-prod-readonly` plus `prod-ff-operator` for temporary flag toggles. We prefer JIT (just-in-time) prod admin for anything beyond that.
lina: Also file the request with manager approval. Security needs a short justification. Use this mini-template: team / env / roles / reason / duration / manager. I'll help approve once it's in.
infra-bot: Automated helper: docs -> https://go/redwood/access-matrix. CLI: `./infra/request_access --env prod --role prod-ff-operator --duration 4h --reason "investigate-customer-1234"`
sam: FYI — if the flag toggle could affect customers, add the customer ticket ID and notify #ff-changes and CS. For rollbacks, set `platform-oncall` as an approver in the request so we can coordinate if needed. :+1:
chloe: One follow-up: for running CI tests against Console API, should I ask to be added to the team service account or create a personal key?
ben: Use the team SA (team-ml-ci). Personal service accounts with prod scope are discouraged. If you need short-lived creds, request rotating tokens from platform. I can add you to team-ml-ci once you confirm.
lina: Audit note: all prod FF toggles are logged with the actor and comment. If this is linked to a customer regression, include the ticket ID in the request to make audits easier.
chloe: Confirmed. Please add me to `team-ml-ci` and I'll file the infra request with the template. Filing now. Thanks!
ben: Heres a pasteable request body you can drop in infra-requests:
```
team: ml-core
env: prod
roles: [prod-ff-operator, console-prod-readonly]
reason: investigate-customer-1234 latency regression
duration: 4h
manager: sam
```
chloe: Request filed and added @lina for approvals. Thanks everyone for the quick guidance :)
